contract.submit: Create setup/permission proposal for CEO; no credential/MCP grant or external service call
Record approve/decline after server checks and checked receipt; approval is not task execution
contract.permission: CEO decision authority for exactly displayed scope

contract.submit: Create evaluation proposal in CEO queue; does not start evaluation
Apply changes parent query only; filtered-empty is explicit
contract.failure: Preserve draft; error distinct from empty

contract.submit: Open exact linked task or decision; mark-read only after receipt
contract.permission: No fabricated alerts or company presence

contract.submit: Read-only comparison; proposed owner selection updates draft only
Open /hq/decisions/[id] for a persisted proposal; no business execution
contract.failure: Missing evidence labelled; unsupported claims cannot become facts

contract.submit: Record changes-requested and preserve prior proposal
Create persisted CEO decision proposal; no package install/binding application until exact approval and authorized command
contract.failure: Preserve draft; no false applied state
contract.permission: Does not activate employee or grant tools/data

contract.submit: Record correction proposal and affected tasks; preserve original evidence
contract.permission: No destructive deletion or retention interpretation

contract.submit: Save source draft/metadata in isolated workspace; no external ingestion assumed
contract.failure: Retain safe input; no invented extract
contract.permission: Source import scope and rights checked separately

contract.submit: Attach checked source references to draft, with version/hash
contract.permission: Source read plus draft edit authorization

contract.submit: Read-only diff and dependent task impact

nodes.name: Task-specific readiness assessment

required: current proposed task requirements or task revision
exact proposed candidate identity and binding revision
context.missing_or_stale: Return unknown or blocked with the named missing requirements; no competence score or implied capability.

inputs: required skills/versions and explicitly approved alternatives
dependency, tool/data permission and company activation states
contract.effect: Compute an inspectable comparison within the current component using AGENT_SKILL_PROFILE_CONTRACT.json. Separate globally available packages from bindings, evidence and access.
contract.success: Show matched requirements and individually missing instructions, dependencies, permissions and evidence with provenance/freshness; no invented competence percentage.
contract.failure: Retain the task draft and show unknown/stale/forbidden inputs explicitly. Do not silently treat missing evidence as zero or equivalent skill packages.
contract.permission: Read only authorized metadata. Assessment cannot assign a skill, activate an employee, grant a tool or start a task.

nodes.generation: inline profile/composer component only; no new generation

nodes.name: Inspect checked skill-binding change receipt

required: existing authorized skill-change id and revision
checked application receipt if one exists
context.missing_or_stale: Show pending, unavailable or superseded decision/receipt; never imply applied.

inputs: authorized application command receipt and resulting binding revision when present
contract.effect: Inspect the exact decision and receipt in the existing detail component; compare proposal/approval/material binding versions. No command is executed by opening this component.
contract.success: Distinguish proposed, awaiting decision, rejected, approved-not-applied, applied-with-verified-receipt and superseded/conflict. Applied is shown only for a matching authoritative receipt/readback.
contract.failure: Keep the original proposal visible; unreadable or missing receipt remains unknown, with retry. No false applied state.
contract.permission: Read scope is checked independently. Approval of an association never activates a company identity or grants tool/data access. Applying a binding remains a separately authorized command.

nodes.generation: inline receipt component only; no new page, overlay or route
nodes.provenance: HQ_SURFACE_INVENTORY.json#change, existing change-3 edge and governed skill-change contract

nodes.name: Edit scoped viewer UI preferences

required: authenticated viewer preference scope and current preference revision
context.missing_or_stale: Retain current view; do not guess preference fields, business permissions or an account scope.

inputs: AR/EN display locale and explicitly supported non-business UI preference fields
contract.effect: Validate and save only supported viewer UI preferences through its scoped command, then display authoritative readback in the same settings component. Locale uses inline:locale-switch behavior.
contract.success: Show saved fields/revision only after a checked receipt; preserve draft and active locale until confirmation.
contract.cancel: Restore last authoritative preferences without business mutation.
contract.failure: Keep draft and prior applied preferences; distinguish validation, forbidden, conflict and unknown receipt.
contract.permission: No pricing, organizational authority, credentials, tool/data permissions or company activation fields belong to this component.

nodes.generation: existing settings component only; no new route or overlay
nodes.provenance: HQ_SURFACE_INVENTORY.json#settings existing locale/preferences action; unsupported preference fields remain outside this contract

nodes.name: AR/EN locale switch

context.identity: Current local viewer preference; does not assume an active company employee
context.required: A supported EN or AR locale value; preserve current route, authorized object id and safe unsaved draft

inputs: requested supported locale EN or AR
current route and safe local draft context
contract.effect: Change display language and direction in the existing shell/component: EN LTR or AR RTL. Do not navigate to a new page or dispatch business work.
contract.success: The same authorized record remains open with translated labels and mirrored direction; record only a viewer preference if its scoped persistence contract is authorized.
contract.failure: Retain the previous working locale and draft; show localized retry guidance without claiming the preference was saved.
contract.permission: UI locale is separate from company activation, skill assignment and tool/data permission.

nodes.generation: component state only; no screen, overlay or route added
nodes.provenance: CEO bilingual/RTL requirement and existing shell-locale edge

nodes.scope: Only explicitly included routes; no generic calendar/widget/account links
